smell.name: long_method
smell.description: Methods that are too long and do too many things

indicators.indicator: Hard to understand what the method does

smell.name: large_class
smell.description: Classes that are too large and have too many responsibilities

smell.name: long_parameter_list
smell.description: Methods with too many parameters, making them hard to use and understand

indicators.indicator: Parameters that could be grouped into objects

smell.name: duplicate_code
smell.description: Similar or identical code in multiple places

indicators.indicator: Same logic implemented in different ways

technique.name: extract_method
technique.description: Extract a portion of a large method into a new, well-named method
technique.when_to_use: When a method is doing multiple things or has complex logic

steps.step: Identify cohesive code block to extract
Create new method with descriptive name
Replace original code with method call
Test that behavior is preserved

technique.name: extract_class
technique.description: Extract related functionality into a separate class
technique.when_to_use: When a class has multiple responsibilities or large sections

steps.step: Identify cohesive responsibility group
Create new class with single responsibility
Move relevant methods and properties
Update original class to use new class
Test both classes independently

technique.name: replace_conditional_with_polymorphism
technique.description: Replace complex conditional logic with polymorphic objects
technique.when_to_use: When you have type-specific behavior scattered in conditionals

steps.step: Create base class/interface for common behavior
Create specific classes for each type
Replace conditional logic with polymorphic calls
Test all type-specific behaviors

technique.name: introduce_parameter_object
technique.description: Group related parameters into a single object
technique.when_to_use: When methods have too many parameters or related parameters

steps.step: Create interface/type for parameter group
Update method signature to use parameter object
Update all method calls to pass parameter object
Test with parameter object

technique.name: move_method
technique.description: Move method to a more appropriate class
technique.when_to_use: When method is used more by another class than its current class

steps.step: Identify target class that uses the method most
Move method to target class
Update current class to use method via target class
Update all method calls
Test both classes

technique.name: inline_method
technique.description: Replace simple method call with method body directly

steps.step: Verify method is simple and only called once
Replace method call with method body
Remove the original method
Test that behavior is unchanged

pattern.name: strategy
pattern.description: Encapsulate algorithms and make them interchangeable
pattern.when_to_use: When you have multiple ways to do something and need to choose at runtime

pattern.name: factory
pattern.description: Create objects without specifying their exact classes
pattern.when_to_use: When you need to create different types based on input

pattern.name: observer
pattern.when_to_use: When multiple objects need to react to changes in one object
